features.name: Size
features.description: small; global size adjustments apply only once.

features.name: Type
features.description: humanoid (rabbit)

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: 40 feet land; distinct movement modes.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Begins speaking Common and Loporrit. High INT bonus options: Abyssal Celestial Elvaan Galkan Goblin Orc.

features.name: Nimble Faller
features.description: Fall damage treated as 10 ft less and land feet first; +1 CMD vs trip.

features.name: Handy
features.description: Choose exactly one Craft/Profession specialty to receive +2 racial bonus.

features.name: Keen Senses
features.description: +2 Perception.

features.name: Nimble
features.description: Use DEX rather than STR to modify Climb and Swim.

features.name: Sprinter
features.description: +10 feet on charge, run and withdraw actions; 40-ft normal speed already included.

features.name: Low-Light Vision
features.description: See twice as far in dim light.

features.name: Scent
features.description: Scent ability.

features.name: Clever Bunny
features.description: +4 racial Bluff, Diplomacy and Sense Motive.

features.name: Climber
features.description: Climb speed 20 ft with usual +8 Climb for unusual actions.

features.name: Curiosity
features.description: +4 Diplomacy only to gather information; Knowledge (history/local) class skills, or +4 racial if class already grants skill.

features.name: Engineer
features.description: +2 Craft (alchemy) and Knowledge (engineering).

features.name: Explorer
features.description: +2 Climb and one chosen Knowledge specialty.

features.name: Hydaelyn’s Spark
features.description: +2 Knowledge (history) OR Linguistics only for patterns, logistics and finding items in groups.

features.name: Natural Hunter
features.description: +2 Perception, Stealth and Survival.

features.name: Purpose-Driven
features.description: Select one class skill from Knowledge (History), Heal, Performance or Diplomacy.
